A reviewer wrote that names like Root, Admin, Null, and Main are role words in this fixture, not people. The generated person span is Morgan Jordan. Values like support@example.invalid and 555-0100 appear only in instructions, while generated contact labels are emmitt@example.net and 555-0155. The generated postal clue is 82261-2075, and the generated source address is 2001:db8::203e:192.0.2.156. This makes name-like and contact-like distractors explicit.
